first_step.how: Email contact@space1026.com or call 215.574.7630 and ask how to join the Vaudvillains brigade. Space 1026's pages do not describe how to join the brigade.

records.notes: The lineup spells it Vaudvillains NYB. Space 1026 spells it Vaudevillains New Year's Brigade; the lineup spelling is kept here, and the orchestrator should pick one. The address and contact details are Space 1026's general details from its own pages, not a contact published by the brigade. Space 1026's posts run through 2026 but none mention the brigade, so status rests on the 2026 lineup. The mother club is Murray (see Rich Porco's Murray Comic Club).

notes: All 42 batch units are covered by 14 records. Murray, Goodtimers and Landi are mother-club records carrying 16, 11 and 4 brigade leads. Vaudvillains NYB has its own record because it has a clubhouse (Space 1026). The 10 wench brigades get one record each, and 9 of them are named on the Mummers Museum listing; MGK is lineup-only and low confidence. Budget: all 6 WebSearch calls used (cap reached), 8 WebFetch calls (one failed). The parade lineup and home pages link to no club websites, and the Mummers Museum site lists no clubs or addresses. No club in this batch has its own website. The only published clubhouse is Vaudvillains (Space 1026, 844 N Broad Street). Status is active for all 42 on the strength of the 2026 New Year's Day lineup (last_sign_of_life 2026-01); no other dated evidence was found. No public join route was found for any unit, so first_step is either a call to the Mummers Museum (215-336-3050) or an email to Space 1026. Dues and meeting times are not published in anything I read. audience.open_to is left out of every record because no source says who can join, and it is a required field, so the importer will probably hold these until someone confirms how to join. The batch file has no id field, so match.group_id is null and matching relies on lead_ids. The Vaudvillains lead is left out of the Murray lead_ids to avoid a double match. Spelling: the lineup says Vaudvillains, Space 1026 says Vaudevillains. The 2026 lineup page is the basis for dating the parade (New Year's Day 2026).
